scope: Task13-14 survivor exploratory; one fixed hypothesis across US and KR; no isolated economic promotion
source: sealed H1 R0 CORE adjusted panels, native eligible bars and AS_OF regimes, and existing H1 rank factor
hypothesis: The slope of forward rank on signed price distance becomes more positive as previously established stock trend and contemporaneous market conditions each become more supportive. Negative distance can favor mean reversion in weak states; favorable states can strengthen continuation. Positive interaction coefficient is the prespecified sign.
distance: D = log(C[t]/SMA20[t]) / (sqrt(20)*std20(log(C/Cprev), ddof=0)); require positive volatility. Within eligible date rank D to percentiles centred on sample mean.
stock_trend: T = (log(C[t-20])-log(C[t-83])) / sum(abs(daily log returns) from t-82 through t-20); 63 returns, bounded [-1,+1]; require positive path length and 84 consecutive valid closes through signal. Earlier window avoids defining trend using the deviation episode itself.
market_state: M maps existing same-date closing AS_OF UP/REBOUND to +1, DOWN/CRASH to -1, SIDEWAYS/TRANSITION to 0; UNKNOWN/WARMUP excluded. No VIX, breadth proxy, EX_POST, new gates or fitted state thresholds.
interaction: Single term D_rank*(T+M)/2. Equal fixed weight. Centre within date before regression. Market state alone has constant cross-sectional scores, so report its association with average raw H20 by state separately.
comparator: Same-sample REV5, MOM20, MOM63, signed D alone, T alone, existing H1 raw score, existing AS_OF state only, additive OLS against otherwise identical OLS plus one interaction. Additive controls include percentile ranks of REV5, MOM20, MOM63, D, T, VOL20, H1 and centred D_rank squared.
label: Market calendar t close, t+1 open to t+21 open, all 21 positive finite opens require existing eligibility. Adjusted returns for research only. No filling or shifting across missing market sessions.
fit: 2023-04-03 through 2023-12-31 H20 ending strictly before 2024-01-01. Equal date weight and equally weighted names within dates, centred percentile response, fixed OLS. Freeze fitted coefficients across evaluation.
evaluation: 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31 H20 ending no later than 2024-12-31. Both periods exposed previously, these are chronological research splits.
eligibility: At least 50 eligible names per date, 80 fit dates and 100 evaluation dates per market. Future prices are labels only. Future validity mask sets common evaluation observations, never cross-sectional feature ranks or fitted score order. Rank predictors on past-only eligible names.
primary: Equal-day mean difference full vs additive out-of-fitting-sample cross-sectional H20 RankIC. Two market tests, one-sided positive Holm 2. Circular common-date 42-session block inference with 5000 draws, seed 131420, includes ineligible calendar slots. Display Bonferroni 45 including 43 H1-era reserved slots as a lower bound on historical multiplicity, not a complete global correction.
candidate_gate: Per market require positive fitted interaction coefficient, positive delta in both 2024 calendar halves, positive lower 95% limit and Holm p<0.05, Bonferroni45 p<0.05, positive actual full upper-quintile mean lift against additive using identical dates and positive incremental rank MSE contribution after deleting the five largest absolute name contributions. If delta <=0 and upper-quintile lift <=0, NO_INCREMENTAL_SIGNAL. Else if not passing, INCONCLUSIVE. Stop without changing horizon/sign/windows; a survivor research pass never opens Task15 by itself.
diagnostics: Same masks for RankIC and tail returns, half-year and AS_OF state stability, with return distributions by D lower/upper quintile and T sign within market state, no post-hoc filtering. No portfolio, transaction costs or trading rules.
budget: One replayable sealed label-analysis run, no substitute following a negative result, zero market data requests or approved economic experiments
